title: The Rule of 72: Wealth vs Debt Math
hook_text: YOUR DEBT DOUBLES FASTER THAN YOUR SAVINGS

beats.say: Your debt doubles way faster than your savings, and it's all thanks to one hidden rule.
beats.visual: A dark room lit by a single desk lamp, a calendar page torn off.

beats.say: It's called the Rule of 72, and it explains why wealth feels so slow to build.
beats.visual: A close-up of a silver calculator on a dark wooden table.

beats.say: At an 8% investment return, your money doubles every 9 years.
beats.visual: A hand placing a single gold coin onto a stack.

beats.say: That's steady. That's how compounding builds a quiet fortune over decades.
beats.visual: Time-lapse of shadows moving across a minimalist concrete wall.

beats.say: But here's the part nobody mentions. The exact same math applies to what you owe.
beats.visual: A fountain pen signing a dark paper document, slightly out of focus.

beats.say: At a 24% interest rate, your credit card debt doubles every 3 years.
beats.visual: A red LED digital clock glowing in a dark hallway.

beats.say: Think about that. Your money takes 9 years to grow, but debt grows in 3.
beats.visual: A pair of brass balance scales tilting heavily to one side.

beats.say: That's why minimum payments trap you in a cycle that lasts for decades.
beats.visual: A hand sliding a dark credit card back into a leather wallet.

beats.say: You're fighting a math equation where the opponent has a three times speed advantage.
beats.visual: Raindrops sliding down a cold windowpane at night.

beats.say: To beat it, you've got to stop the bleeding before you start investing.
beats.visual: A white ceramic coffee cup sitting on a dark slate counter.

beats.say: Kill the high interest debt first, and that's exactly how
beats.visual: A match being struck, casting a bright orange glow in the dark.

caption: The math doesn't care about your intentions. Know the rules of the game. #RuleOf72 #PersonalFinance #DebtFree #MoneyMindset #WealthBuilding
description: Understanding the Rule of 72 reveals why high-interest debt outpaces investments so quickly. Here is the exact math behind the speed of money.
first_comment: What's the highest interest rate on any debt you've ever paid off?

facts.basis: Rule of 72 calculation: 72 divided by 8 equals 9 years.
Rule of 72 calculation: 72 divided by 24 equals 3 years.
